C0654.title: Brothers Sentenced for Illegally Pirating Over a Thousand Books
C0654.summary: Starting in December 2020, brothers Huang A and Huang B operated an e-commerce store, illegally printing and selling pirated educational workbooks on demand. In December 2022, the court convicted them of copyright infringement, sentencing each to seven months in prison suspended for one year, along with fines and confiscation of illegal gains.
